snippet.title: Carmen Sandiego's ThinkQuick Challenge - Gameplay
snippet.description:
A gameplay video of Carmen Sandiego's ThinkQuick Challenge. Yes, it's that long of a video. And it still looks terrible even at 480p resolution.

I don't remember ever having to use a card catalog back when this game came out while I was in middle school. I still can't say I have fond memories of playing this game back then either.
